requirements.label: 120 Total Credits
requirements.hint: The BM in Performance: String Instruments requires a minimum of 120 credits. Requirements follow the 2024-2025 Silent Advisor; SMTD students follow the curriculum of their admit year.

requirements.label: Non-Music credits (30)
requirements.hint: At least 30 credits outside music. Courses within Arts Administration, Dance, and Theatre also count as non-Music.

requirements.label: Music Theory core (Aural and Written Skills I-IV)
requirements.hint: THEORY 139, 149, 140, 150, 239, 249, 240, and 250. The aural and written skills sequences run across the first two years. JAZZ 220 can be taken in place of THEORY 239 and 249, and JAZZ 221 in place of THEORY 240 and 250 (use an override if you substitute).

requirements.label: Musicology core
requirements.hint: MUSICOL 139 Intro to the Study of Music, 140 History of U.S. Musics, 239 History of Music, and 240 History of Western Music.

requirements.label: 400 level Musicology, Theory, or listed Jazz elective (3 credits)
requirements.hint: One 400 level Musicology or Theory elective, or JAZZ 460, 467, 470, or 479.

requirements.label: Class Piano (through PIANO 112 or proficiency)
requirements.hint: PIANO 110, 111, and 112, or demonstrated proficiency. If you place out of any level, use the adjust control to mark it satisfied.

requirements.label: ENS 345: University Orchestra (8 terms)
requirements.hint: Two credits of ENS 345 University Orchestra, elected eight terms (every term of the program).

requirements.label: Small ensemble (3 terms)
requirements.hint: Three terms of small ensemble, ENS 335 String Quartet for violin, viola, and cello, or ENS 325 plus two terms of ENS 335 for double bass. The planner counts one election; repeat it across terms.

requirements.label: Performance lessons (24 credits)
requirements.hint: Private study on violin, viola, cello, or double bass every term, 24 credits total with completion of the 440 level on your instrument.

requirements.label: Studio Class (every term)
requirements.hint: One credit of studio class (450) in your instrument's studio, elected each term together with lessons.

requirements.label: VIOLIN 460: Viola for Violin (violinists)
requirements.hint: Violinists are required to elect VIOLIN 460 Viola for Violin in consultation with faculty. Violists, cellists, and bassists are exempt; mark this met with an override if it does not apply to you.

requirements.label: MUSPERF 440: Senior Recital
requirements.hint: Zero credit capstone recital in the final year, taken alongside the 440 level lessons.

requirements.label: First year writing
requirements.hint: ENGLISH 124, 125, or an equivalent first year writing course.

requirements.label: Upper level writing
requirements.hint: An upper level writing course approved by the Sweetland Writing Center.

requirements.label: Race and Ethnicity course
requirements.hint: One course in Race and Ethnicity selected from approved courses within LSA, or within SMTD by petition. SMTD RE courses will not count into overall non-SMTD credits.
